messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated latency detected for /v1/generate in prod us-east-1. Metric: p95 latency spike > 2s, throughput down ~30%. Triggered 2024-10-30T15:00:00Z. Pager: jen (oncall).
jen (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm booting the triage checklist now. First things first — confirm scale and backlog.
omar (eng-sre): Observed metrics in grafana: p50 ~ 450ms -> 1.1s, p95 ~ 250ms -> 2.4s. GPU util on pool-gpu-east is ~96%, queues show >600 waiting requests, KV cache hit-rate dropped from 82% -> 12% for long-tail prefixes.
mike (eng-runtime): Not a network blip — packet loss normal. Looking at recent deploys: there was a quantized-kernel push 1.3.1 at 14:30 UTC to pool-gpu-east. Could be batching/kernels regressing memory behavior.
jen (oncall): Good catch. Immediate mitigations: 1) divert traffic to fallback variant (redwood-gen-compact) 2) spin up extra dedicated nodes in east pool (scale +2) 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size to lower queue wait. Who can run the routing change?
omar (eng-sre): I can do the routing. Will canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics improve. Routing API call:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","from_variant":"redwood-gen","to_variant":"redwood-gen-compact","percent":10}'
```
jen (oncall): Do it. Also, mike — reduce max_batch_size on pool-gpu-east to 8 (was 32). Config patch:
```
PATCH /infra/configs/pool-gpu-east
{"max_batch_size":8}
```
omar (eng-sre): Canary 10% applied at 15:08Z. Early signals: p95 down to ~1.3s for canary traffic, overall p95 marginally improved to 1.8s. Proceeding to 50% now.
sam (support): Heads-up — customers are noticing slow responses. We should post a short status update and a customer-facing advisory. Draft for status page: 
"We are investigating elevated latency for the Generation API in US-East. Some requests may experience slower responses or timeouts. Mitigation in progress; engineers are routing traffic to a lower-latency model variant. We will post updates every 15 minutes."
jen (oncall): That reads fine. Proposed public update (status page API):
```
POST https://status.redwood.ai/incidents
{
  "component":"Generation API (us-east-1)",
  "status":"investigating",
  "message":"We're investigating elevated latency affecting some requests to the Generation API in US-East. Traffic is being routed to a fallback model variant while we mitigate. Expect periodic updates every 15 minutes."
}
```
jen (oncall): Internal teams — please use the customer template below if you get inbound tickets: 
"Hi — we’re aware of elevated latency affecting the Generation API in US-East. Our engineers are routing traffic to a fallback model variant and scaling capacity. We estimate reduced impact within 20–40 minutes; we’ll follow up when the issue is resolved. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Support"
product-sam: Can you include a note about potential cost impact for orgs on Dedicated? Also advise that embeddings and non-generation endpoints unaffected unless routed to same pool.
mike (eng-runtime): Scale +2 nodes applied at 15:14Z. Reduced batch size applied. Observing GPU memory pressure drop; KV cache warming for compact variant is currently happening.
omar (eng-sre): Canary at 50% now. Metrics improving: overall p95 down to 1.1s, queue depth halved. Proceeding to 100% at 15:20Z.
jen (oncall): I'm posting the first status update now. Scheduling updates at 15:30Z and 15:45Z.
deploy-bot: Deployment event — rollback flag detected: reverting kernel 1.3.1 -> 1.3.0 on pool-gpu-east at 15:27Z (automated safe-rollback).
omar (eng-sre): Rollback started. After rollback and full traffic on compact variant, p95 stabilized at ~320ms, throughput back to ~95% baseline by 15:40Z.
sam (support): I just pushed the customer-facing notification to our support portal and emailed active Dedicated contacts with the template.
jen (oncall): Handing off monitoring to mike for post-incident observation and RCA. Summary for handoff: root cause likely regression in quantized kernel 1.3.1 causing KV cache thrash and memory spikes; immediate mitigations were: route to compact variant, reduce batch size, scale nodes, rollback kernel. Current status: service stable, 15:42Z. Follow-up ticket INC-4321 created for root cause analysis and long-term mitigations (better canary for kernel, autoscaling thresholds, KV cache fallbacks).
mike (eng-runtime): Taking handoff. I'll keep watch for 2 hours and then pass to infra on-call. Leaving note: ensure the canary rollout policy includes GPU memory stress tests.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Elevated latency incident for Generation API in us-east-1 resolved at 2024-10-30T15:42:00Z. Impact: increased latency and partial request failures for ~40 minutes. Mitigations: routing to fallback variant, scale up nodes, config change, rollback of kernel 1.3.1. Follow-up: INC-4321 (assigned to eng-runtime) for detailed RCA and prevention.
